rule: Implementation objectives must pass an existing-capability check before creation or execution.
why: Prevent duplicate builds, stale objective revival, parser forks, route duplication, and losing known-good solutions while Dave is away.
operator_facing_summary_template: I checked whether we already have this. Reuse candidate: {reuse_candidate}. Blocked because: {blocked_because}. Next bounded step: {next_bounded_task}.
do_not: start implementation from freeform objective text alone
rebuild an existing route or parser
mark complete without material implementation proof
treat a new wrapper artifact as fresh execution evidence
ask Dave to rediscover context already in continuity memory
